description:
A fund's latest SEC Form 13F portfolio: total value, number of positions, top holdings with % of portfolio,
and what changed vs the quarter before: new positions, positions sold out, biggest adds and biggest cuts. Use for
'what did Berkshire buy last quarter?', 'top holdings of Bridgewater', 'did Ark sell Tesla?'.
